product_metadata.title: Selamica Porcelain Fluted Latte Bowl Set - 10 Ounce for Rice, Soup, Snacks - Set of 6, Assorted colors
features: PRACTICAL HANDY BOWLS - The size of 4.5 inch is practical for rice, meal prep, dessert, snacks, salad, etc. If you want to keep fit, these bowls are also a good choice for diet control .
STYLISH DESIGN - Fashionable and fantastic for your table and the white color goes easily with many other crockery items. The stylish fluted design makes the bowls easy to hold HOT and COLD items.
STACKABLE & EASY CLEANING - The bowls is covered with smooth and shiny glaze that you don't need to worry about how to keep it clean after use it.

SAFE AND HEALTHY - Selamica consist on providing healthy and convenience to all our customers. We use top-grade porcelain which is non-toxic and lead-free. You can use them with MICROWAVE, OVEN, DISHWASHER and FREEZER.
PACK OF 6 - Enough for your needs of serving family banquet, suitable for all occasions for pre-dinner preparation or after-dinner desserts.
